description: PlanForge — Describe. Design. Estimate. A hackathon-ready open-source MVP for creating preliminary house layouts from natural-language requirements, validating room geometry, editing a 2D floor plan, and calculating transparent area-based construction estimates. Demo Mode must always work without credentials. Gemma 4 AI Mode is conditional on official verification of a supported model identifier/API and server-side configuration. The app must not present outputs as professional, safe, or construction-ready designs, nor estimates as quotations.

services.description: Responsive React single-page application using Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Lucide React, and React Konva/Konva; includes project form, floor-plan editor, cost dashboard, saved projects, and about/open-source information.

services.name: PlanForge API
services.description: Python FastAPI service with Pydantic models, deterministic layout generation and geometry validation, area-based cost estimation, health/config endpoints, and an optional server-side Gemma integration using HTTPX.

constraints: No paid service is required to run Demo Mode.
Gemma 4 model ID, endpoint, and request format must be verified from official documentation before integration; never fabricate them.
AI credentials must remain server-side and absent from source, frontend bundles, screenshots, and documentation.
Layout validation is geometric only and cannot establish architectural or structural safety.
Cost calculations are preliminary area-based sample estimates with explicit assumptions, rates, sources/status, exclusions, and uncertainty; no duplicate charges.
Prepare README.md, MIT LICENSE if appropriate, .gitignore, .env.example, tests, and DEMO_SCRIPT.md; do not publish or push externally without confirmation.
Do not claim untested behavior. Prioritize a working MVP over advanced features.
